Date: September 14-16, 2026

Location: Houston, TX, USA

The posit::conf(2026) brings together open source users and professional organizations that use R and Python Data Science tools.

Open Source Quantitative Finance Conference

Date: October 23-24, 2026

Location: The University of Illinois Chicago, IL, USA

Academics and finance professionals explore current trends in applying open source programming languages to financial model development, portfolio construction, risk management, and trading. Key topics include AI, advanced risk tools, econometrics, portfolio management, and time series analysis.

https://www.osqf.org/
